newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico anti-drug chief suffers heart attack.
newsitem.headline: Mexico anti-drug chief suffers heart attack.

text.p: Mexico's top anti-drug warrior suffered a heart attack complicated by diabetes but was recovering in a hospital, a government spokesman said on Monday.
The spokesman denied as "totally false" local rumours that Gen. Jesus Gutierrez Rebollo, 62, head of Mexico's National Institute for the Combat of Drugs (INCD), had died or committed suicide.
"He is recovering in the Central Military Hospital," the spokesman said. "The doctors say he may be discharged this weekend or next week."
He said Gutierrez suffered his heart attack on Feb. 7.

An army general appointed to the delicate job last December, Gutierrez Rebollo was highly regarded by the Mexican government and by Washington for the results he obtained in the war on drugs while in the military.
